'''Groldan's Excavation''' is an extensive dwarven digsite located to the northeast of [[Lake Kithas]] in the [[Grim Reaches]], led by [[Groldan Blackforge]] of the [[Explorers' League]]. However, the dig site has been attacked by [[Dark Iron dwarves]] under the cover of night, slaughtering most of the League's prospectors and miners. The survivors have gathered in [[Dun Kithas]].
